items.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021
items.q: “Hey do you have Jimmy Scott ‘Falling in Love is Wonderful?’” “No, sorry it’s out of print.”

ctx.x: I would not have guessed that.

Most requested. And here’s a typical conversation. “Hey do you have Jimmy Scott ‘Falling in Love is Wonderful?’” “No, sorry it’s out of print.” “Well could you order it for me? Could you somehow obtain one? Can you copy it for me?” That was the absolute most requested album. I mean other than Stevie Wonder “Songs in the Key of Life” I’m talking about an anomoly okay? And I thought if I ever obtain that record like in a record collection, because that was part of what I did I bought record collections as well. I…

I ever obtain this record I’m going to get a fortune for it. I am going to gouge them, I’m going to get a fortune for this record. So I don’t know years into my ownership of the record store I got one while obtaining a record collection I couldn’t believe it. Did I sell it? No way. Everybody wanted that record. I kept it, okay? I could have gotten all that money. And that is a — one example of how I learned from my customers, even though I knew plenty of stuff my customers knew more and I learned about what…

items.title: Jerry Gordon interviewed by Monk Rowe and Christian Goodwillie, via Zoom, June 30, 2021
items.q: the most requested record in my store in its history was Little Jimmy Scott “Falling in Love is Wonderful.”

ctx.x: Did you get regular customers coming in who eventually would ask you your opinion?

That’s what my store was all about. When I opened the store I went to the various one- stops in the city — a one-stop is a place that carried records from all the majors. So instead of having to have an account with Polygram, an account with Warner Brothers, an account with Columbia, and often they didn’t want to give you credit as a start-up business, you could go to a one-stop, who carried records from all the companies. And I went to the one-stops, I introduced myself and I said, “Hi, I’m Jerry Gordon and I’m…
I would not have guessed that.
